title: Plan: briefly treat Spirit-wrought inherent righteousness
source_text: III. Ad calumniae hujus depulsionem visum est paucis agere de justitia & sanctitate illa quam in anima fideli Spiritus Sanctus operatur, ac quid & quantum ei Reformati tribuant breviter exponere.
pass_a_gloss: For the repelling of this calumny it has seemed good to treat briefly of that righteousness and holiness which the Holy Spirit works in the believing soul, and to set forth shortly what and how much the Reformed ascribe to it.
pass_b_english: To rebut the calumny, briefly treat the Spirit's justice and holiness in the believing soul.
State what and how much the Reformed ascribe to it.

choices.why: Key lemma for De Justitia densify §1037.
